title: 并联电容经电阻网络放电
statement: 图示电路中 Us = 10 V，R1 = 1 kΩ，R2 = 6 kΩ，R3 = 3 kΩ，R4 = 2 kΩ，C1 = 20 µF，C2 = 30 µF。开关 S 闭合已久，t = 0 时断开。
求时间常数 τ、C1 的电流 i_C1(0₊)、R3 的电流 i_3(0₊)，以及 t = 0.4 s 时的 u_C。

questions.explain: C1 ∥ C2 = 50 µF；从电容看进去 R_eq = R4 + R2 ∥ R3 = 2 + 2 = 4 kΩ（R1 已随 S 断开），τ = 4×10³ × 50×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s。
u_C(0₊) = 8 V，放电电流 8 V / 4 kΩ = 2 mA 由两个电容按电容量分担：C1 提供 2 × 20/50 = 0.8 mA，从上极板流出，所以 i_C1(0₊) = −0.8 mA。

hints: C1、C2 直接并联，可以合并成一个 50 µF 的电容。
t < 0 时电容开路，u_C(0₋) 由 R1 与 (R4 + R2 ∥ R3) 分压得到。
并联电容的电流按电容量成正比分配：i = C du/dt，两电容 du/dt 相同。
solution: **2. 换路后。** S 断开，Us 与 R1 不再起作用。等效电容 C = C1 + C2 = 50 µF，等效电阻 R_eq = 4 kΩ，**τ = R_eq·C = 0.2 s**。
**4. 0₊ 时刻的电流。** 总放电电流 i_R4(0₊) = 8/4 = 2 mA（从 a 流向 b）。两个电容端电压相同，电流与电容量成正比：C1 提供 0.8 mA，C2 提供 1.2 mA。按图中参考方向 **i_C1(0₊) = −0.8 mA**。

en.title: Parallel capacitors discharging through a resistor network
statement: In the circuit, Us = 10 V, R1 = 1 kΩ, R2 = 6 kΩ, R3 = 3 kΩ, R4 = 2 kΩ, C1 = 20 µF, C2 = 30 µF. Switch S has been closed for a long time and opens at t = 0.
Find the time constant τ, the current i_C1(0+) of C1, the current i_3(0+) in R3, and u_C at t = 0.4 s.

questions.explain: C1 ∥ C2 = 50 µF; seen from the capacitors R_eq = R4 + R2 ∥ R3 = 2 + 2 = 4 kΩ (R1 is cut off by S), τ = 4×10³ × 50×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s.

u_C(0+) = 8 V; the discharge current 8 V / 4 kΩ = 2 mA is shared by the two capacitors in proportion to their capacitance: C1 supplies 2 × 20/50 = 0.8 mA, leaving its top plate, so i_C1(0+) = −0.8 mA.
The 2 mA in R4 divides between R2 and R3: i_3 = 2 × 6/(6 + 3) = 4/3 ≈ 1.333 mA.

hints: C1 and C2 are directly in parallel and can be combined into one 50 µF capacitor.
For t < 0 the capacitors are open; u_C(0−) comes from the divider formed by R1 and (R4 + R2 ∥ R3).
Parallel capacitors share current in proportion to capacitance: i = C du/dt with the same du/dt for both.
solution: **1. t = 0−.** The capacitors are open; the resistance to the right of a is R4 + R2 ∥ R3 = 2 + 2 = 4 kΩ, which forms a divider with R1: u_C(0−) = 10 × 4/(1 + 4) = 8 V.
**2. After switching.** S is open, so Us and R1 play no part. Equivalent capacitance C = C1 + C2 = 50 µF, equivalent resistance R_eq = 4 kΩ, **τ = R_eq·C = 0.2 s**.
**3. Zero-input response.** u_C(t) = 8e^(−5t) V. At t = 0.4 s: u_C = 8e⁻² ≈ **1.083 V**.

**4. Currents at 0+.** Total discharge current i_R4(0+) = 8/4 = 2 mA (from a to b). Both capacitors have the same voltage, so their currents are proportional to capacitance: C1 supplies 0.8 mA and C2 1.2 mA. With the reference arrow, **i_C1(0+) = −0.8 mA**.
Current division between R2 and R3: **i_3(0+) = 2 × 6/9 ≈ 1.333 mA**, i_2(0+) = 0.667 mA. All currents decay with the same e^(−5t).
